value.rationale: The natural question of whether two isotropic oscillator shell measurements can jointly eliminate blind Fourier spheres is answered completely through excitation level four across all dimensions. The first failure is unexpectedly in dimensions 6 and 24 only, and an exact functional-analytic Lp transition distinguishes recoverable and nonrecoverable data. This is a motivated complete low-energy classification with structural Helmholtz nullspaces, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a known-value reprint; higher-level extrapolation is explicitly unproved.
